title: Synthetic Neuro-Architecture for Planning, Adaptation, Navigation, Sensing, and Evolution
interpretation: Functional engineering analogies only; no claim of biological equivalence or consciousness.

regions.function: Goal representation, task decomposition, planning, sequencing, stopping rules.
regions.system: Manager / Team Conductor
regions.gap: Make plans, constraints, and stop conditions machine-readable across all orchestration entry points.

regions.function: Flexible coordination, resource allocation, switching between strategies and parallel work.
regions.system: Manager policy + dependency-phase admission routing
regions.gap: Add explicit cross-run coordination and budget-aware policy comparison.

regions.function: Conflict monitoring, error detection, sustained task-set control, escalation signals.
regions.system: Review gates, repo-gate, tests, conflict and retry accounting
regions.gap: Unify conflict, uncertainty, and intervention events into one review/escalation contract.

regions.function: Detect salient changes and prioritize which signal deserves control resources.
regions.system: Triage, incident detection, provider availability and task prioritization
regions.gap: Define a cross-domain salience score with explicit false-positive and missed-event measurements.

regions.function: Offline synthesis, scenario generation, reflection, connecting distant concepts.
regions.system: Research, retrospective synthesis, idea generation and architecture proposal lane
regions.gap: Create a bounded research mode that produces hypotheses, not autonomous production changes.

regions.function: Sustained goal-directed attention and targeted retrieval.
regions.system: Repository watchers, targeted context queries, scheduled observation
regions.gap: Formalize watch subscriptions, freshness windows, and attention budgets.

regions.function: Interrupt and reorient when unexpected high-priority events occur.
regions.system: Unexpected CI failures, security alerts, provider outages, review blockers
regions.gap: Implement event severity, deduplication, suppression, and escalation policy.

regions.function: Bind episodes, entities, events, and context into retrievable relationships.
regions.system: Context Relationship Graph / Historical Corpus
regions.gap: Improve recency, provenance, retrieval confidence, and explicit forgetting/retention policy.

regions.function: Semantic concepts, durable facts, labels, and conceptual relationships.
regions.system: Documentation, notation registries, schemas, provider and agent catalogs
regions.gap: Introduce a versioned concept registry with aliases, owners, source evidence, and deprecation state.

regions.function: Gate and relay signals between sensing, control, memory, and action systems.
regions.system: ICM / MCP gateway / provider and tool dispatch
regions.gap: Standardize typed routing envelopes, capability checks, deadlines, and trace correlation.

regions.function: Select one action or policy among competing candidates; inhibit unsafe or redundant actions.
regions.system: Admission control, manager policy, specialist eligibility and workflow selection
regions.gap: Make policy selection explainable and retain rejected alternatives with reasons.

regions.function: Translate selected plans into bounded actions.
regions.system: Agent execution adapters, Termux cockpit, GitHub Actions and repository tooling
regions.gap: Use a common action envelope with preconditions, idempotency, scope, and postconditions.

regions.function: Compare intended and observed effects; refine timing and error correction.
regions.system: RECON → PLAN → ACT → WAIT → WATCH → VALIDATE → RE-FETCH → COMPARE → RECORD
regions.gap: Close the loop from outcome deltas to policy updates without automatic retry or unsafe self-modification.

regions.function: Monitor internal state, resource pressure, latency, availability, and operational health.
regions.system: SHE, ATES, WTCV, 3L0, runtime and resource telemetry
regions.gap: Add a unified health vector with provenance and alert thresholds that never substitute for quality gates.

regions.function: Prioritize threat response, preserve boundaries, regulate resource use.
regions.system: Security controls, secret handling, permissions, quotas, device resource guardrails
regions.gap: Map threat classes to explicit deny/contain/escalate responses and auditable authority.

regions.function: Maintain basic readiness, liveness, scheduling, and wake-up signals.
regions.system: Workflow schedules, runtime heartbeat, Termux MCP availability and service health
regions.gap: Define liveness/readiness contracts, stale-run detection, and graceful degradation.

regions.function: Coordinate information transfer between specialized subsystems.
regions.system: Shared event schemas, evidence envelopes, artifact contracts, agent handoffs
regions.gap: Version and validate inter-agent messages, handoff acknowledgements, and schema compatibility.

regions.function: Convert structured state into visual patterns for human inspection.
regions.system: SHE dashboard, Mermaid architecture diagrams, generated automation documentation
regions.gap: Ensure every visualization exposes source SHA, freshness, coverage, and partial-state markers.

regions.function: Interpret incoming language and event streams.
regions.system: Issues, PR discussions, review feedback, CLI input and structured tool results
regions.gap: Normalize input provenance and distinguish quoted/untrusted instructions from authorized commands.

regions.function: Represent relationships, dependencies, ordering, and task topology.
regions.system: Dependency DAGs, context graph topology, file/symbol relationship maps
regions.gap: Connect dependency, ownership, risk, and evidence graphs without conflating candidate edges with verified facts.

regions.function: Assign outcome value and reinforce effective policies over repeated evidence.
regions.system: Moneyball / 3L0 / ATES and manager tournaments
regions.gap: Keep reward multi-objective, quality-constrained, uncertainty-aware, and resistant to metric gaming.

regions.function: Model roles, perspectives, capability boundaries, and disagreement between collaborators.
regions.system: Agent roster, contributor provenance, specialist/manager role model
regions.gap: Build capability-aware handoff and disagreement protocols; do not infer identity from GitHub actor alone.

regions.function: Compress durable learning, reconcile duplicates, decay stale context, and preserve important episodes.
regions.system: Proposed knowledge consolidation and context hygiene lane
regions.gap: Design deterministic, reversible summarization with source links, retention limits, and no silent deletion.

regions.function: Detect unusual combinations or weak signals that do not match existing categories.
regions.system: Proposed novelty and anomaly candidate generator
regions.gap: Test novelty recall and false-positive burden on historical repository events before creating alerts.

regions.function: Adjust how quickly policies and routing rules learn from evidence; control adaptation rate.
regions.system: Proposed policy evolution controller over manager tournaments
regions.gap: Add bounded promotion criteria, rollback, experiment cohorts, and immutable evaluation receipts.

global_invariants: A mapping is an analogy, not evidence of biological equivalence.
Missing telemetry remains unknown/null; never fabricate zero.
Correctness, security, authorization, and human approval outrank reward or throughput.
A declared route receives no execution credit until invocation evidence exists.
A failed action is an observation; retry requires an explicit policy decision.
Candidate graph relationships must never be represented as verified.
Secrets, prompts, completions, and arbitrary tool payloads are excluded from shared evidence unless a separate approved contract explicitly permits them.
Proposed lanes remain non-production until tested and explicitly promoted.
